meta.note: The city past the play box. boxes: [x, z, w, d, h, rot, cls, g], game units, rot = rotation.y (w along local X). cls 0 = the low fabric (DataSF Building Footprints, LiDAR median heights) of a 30 u cell within 560 u of the box edge as one mass (area-weighted height, sized to the built area); cls 1 = an OpenStreetMap building of 40 m or more (its own oriented rectangle) within 700 u of the box (Cathedral Hill, Pacific Heights, the Western Addition, Mission Bay, Potrero). Nothing is boxed across the water: the islands are in islands. g = ground under the box in game units from the terrarium DEM (Pacific Heights 60-110 m, Twin Peaks and Mount Sutro 250 m+, Potrero Hill 90 m): 0 within 40 u of the play box edge and ramped in over the next 60 u so the surround meets the flat play area; lift the backdrop by g (or a share of it), or ignore it. named: index into boxes. water: San Francisco Bay, the Golden Gate strait and the ocean over the fetch area ({name, polygon, holes}); the islands (Alcatraz, Angel Island, Yerba Buena / Treasure Island) are holes of the bay polygon, so a point is wet only inside a polygon and outside its holes; the extract ends at 122.32 W (x = 1480 u), east of which the Oakland shore is not covered. islands: outline polygons with summit heights. masts: Sutro Tower (g = its hilltop). cranes: Port of Oakland container cranes where the extract maps them (it ends just short of most of the port). horizon: far features by bearing (deg clockwise from north) and distance from the origin.

water.name: San Francisco Bay and the Golden Gate

islands.name: Alcatraz
islands.note: bare sandstone rock with the cellhouse, lighthouse and water tower

islands.name: Yerba Buena Island
islands.note: steep wooded island the Bay Bridge tunnels through

islands.name: Treasure Island
islands.note: flat man-made island (1939 fair), low buildings and palms

islands.name: Angel Island
islands.note: wooded hill island (Mount Livermore 240 m) north of Alcatraz

islands.name: Marin shore
islands.note: the headland the in-play Golden Gate Bridge lands on (moved in with it)

horizon.name: Marin Headlands (Hawk Hill, Slacker Hill)
horizon.note: bare golden-brown grass hills falling steeply to the strait behind the Golden Gate Bridge; green in winter, fog pouring over them in summer

horizon.name: Mount Tamalpais
horizon.note: the long dark-green wooded ridge of Marin with its triple summit (East Peak 784 m), the highest thing on the north-west horizon

horizon.name: Angel Island (Mount Livermore)
horizon.note: wooded island hill north of Alcatraz, Tiburon and Belvedere behind it

horizon.name: Berkeley Hills (Grizzly Peak)
horizon.note: the East Bay hills behind Berkeley: a long even ridge, golden grass and dark eucalyptus, the Campanile and the white Claremont hotel at its foot

horizon.name: Oakland Hills (Round Top)
horizon.note: the ridge continues south-east behind downtown Oakland and the container cranes of the Port of Oakland

horizon.name: Mount Diablo
horizon.note: the isolated double-peaked mountain far to the east, seen over the East Bay hills on a clear day

horizon.name: San Bruno Mountain
horizon.note: the long bare ridge that closes the city to the south, radio masts on its crest

horizon.name: Twin Peaks and Mount Sutro
horizon.note: the two bare grassy summits in the middle of the city to the south-west with the red-and-white Sutro Tower beside them on its wooded hill
